model.name: Boots may not name a sprint/version diverging from HEAD, and carry no active-state (currency guard + state-removal cure)
model.description: A rewound agent re-derives its world from its boot.md ACTIVE section; when that section carries STALE state it inherits a dead world = the GHOST-CONTEXT ROOT (measured a7ac8892: expert boots v0.8.61 ~62 versions stale, req S31, planner v0.7.65/S30-S31, while HEAD is S40/v0.8.123; 9 agents booted off these today). Two layers: (Layer 1, interim) a currency guard - for every boot naming a sprint/version in an active-state position, boot.named==gitHEAD.derived else RED, folded into the boot-essence lint via the SAME structuralDiscover (single-source), discovered BY GLOB fleet-wide with a divergence check, fail-closed on unparseable, lessons-headings exempt, own stub-must-fail; (Layer 2, the cure) state-removal - boots become timeless rules + identity + an anchor POINTER to context.md with ZERO state, worded so the guard never ENTRENCHES state-bearing boots as acceptable (WARN now, RED per-file as each cure lands).

acceptanceCriteria.text: For every boot.md that NAMES a sprint/version in an ACTIVE-STATE position, boot.named(sprint,version) == gitHEAD.derived(sprint,version), else RED. gitHEAD.derived = package.json version + the CurrentSprint pin's sprint (single-sourced, the SAME source the app reads). An equality invariant like served==committed.

gateRef.assertion: for each state-bearing boot: named(sprint,version)==HEAD-derived else RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: OBSERVED-RED 4079d157b: seeded stale boot => violation; --strict on the real stale boots exits 1

acceptanceCriteria.text: The currency guard discovers its set by the derived-GLOB PRINCIPLE with a divergence check (the discovered set is computed, never a hand-list; a boot present on disk but unevaluated => RED) — the SAME principle as R40.54 AcGuard and R37.12 live-MVC. HONEST STATE (verified on disk check-boot-currency.ts:18-20 + grep: no shared symbol exists): there is NO literal shared `structuralDiscover` symbol today; R40.54, R37.12 and this lint each implement the principle LOCALLY = 3 copies. The AC requires the PRINCIPLE + divergence (met); the single-SYMBOL extraction that would collapse the 3 copies is recorded as explicit DEBT (see extractionDebt) — NOT papered over, because a satisfied AC claiming 'shared' over 3 copies would be a false-satisfaction breaking our own meta-guard R40.54.

gateRef.assertion: discovery is derived-glob + divergence check (unevaluated on-disk boot => RED); a HAND-LIST => RED. (Symbol-sharing = tracked debt, not asserted here.)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a hand-list discovery (non-derived) -> RED; divergence (unlisted boot) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Discovery is BY GLOB of every session/agents/*/boot.md (INCLUDING other teams: oosh*, @host variants), NEVER a hand-list. Divergence check: a boot file present on disk but NOT in the lint's evaluated set => RED, so a NEW or RENAMED agent boot cannot hide by being unlisted. (This already earned its keep: the architect's glob caught 3 stale oosh* boots that a 7-name robbin list MISSED.)

gateRef.assertion: on-disk boot set == evaluated set; a present-but-unevaluated boot => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: OBSERVED-RED 4079d157b (divergence-sanity): 0-boots / low-count => RED (a shrunken/empty discovered set cannot pass green).

acceptanceCriteria.text: SYMMETRIC fail-closed, BOTH sides of the comparison. (a) COMPARED VALUE: a boot naming a version/sprint the parser CANNOT resolve to a comparable value => RED, never skipped-as-pass (an ambiguous boot is STALE until proven current). (b) TRUTH-SOURCE: if the guard's OWN source is unreadable/absent — package.json version OR the CurrentSprint pin cannot be read — the guard goes RED/error, NEVER pass-green. A guard that silently passes when it cannot read HEAD is exactly the silent-failure class this requirement kills (fail-LOUD, not fail-safe). Same fail-closed posture as the R3 uuid resolver, applied to the compared value AND the comparator's source. (Architect re-inspection hardening 2026-08-20: original AC covered only the boot-parse side.)

gateRef.assertion: boot-unparseable OR truth-source (package.json / CurrentSprint pin) unreadable/absent => RED; never pass-green

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: OBSERVED-RED 4079d157b (truth-source side): blindness case nonexistent-root => RED (guard fails loud when its source is unreadable). Boot-parse-unparseable side: PENDING explicit stub.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A version inside an explicitly-marked lessons heading (e.g. '## Hard-won patterns (v0.6.0 ...)') is PROVENANCE, not active-state, and is EXEMPT — but ONLY under a marked lessons section, NEVER in a ## Current / ## Goal / anchor position. The exemption is ENUMERATED (a named lessons-heading scope), not a blanket 'ignore all versions'. Prevents a false-RED on robbin-tester's v0.6.0 lesson-stamp.

gateRef.assertion: version under a marked lessons heading => exempt; the SAME version in an active-state position => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING dual-control: (a) tester v0.6.0 under lessons heading -> GREEN (no false-RED); (b) same version in a ## Current position -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The currency lint ships with a RED-proving fixture: a seeded boot naming a deliberately-old version MUST make the lint RED. If the stub PASSES, the lint is not wired and CI blocks. Isolated: fixture in scratch, no prod mutation, cleanup-on-failure (R40.31). This is the R40.54 own-failability requirement applied to this lint itself.

gateRef.assertion: the lint's own stub, fed the stale-boot defect, is observed RED before the lint counts as wired

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: OBSERVED-RED 4079d157b: the lint's own --selftest stub (deliberately-old boot) goes RED; passing stub would fail CI

acceptanceCriteria.text: The REAL target (deeper assertion) is that a boot carries NO active-state at all: timeless rules + identity + an ANCHOR POINTER to context.md (refreshed each save) = the R113 shape. ★ STATE IS DEFINED BY THE FACT-vs-FINDER TEST (architect D3 + PO ruling 2026-08-20): a line is STATE if it asserts a FACT ABOUT THE WORLD that ROTS -> STRIP it; a line is TIMELESS if it says HOW TO FIND the fact (a pointer to context.md, a rule, an identity) -> KEEP it. Sprint/version is only the OBVIOUS class; the lint must also catch SUBTLE state that does not look like state, ENUMERATED: (i) transient-git-ref (e.g. stash@{0}, a commit hash used as current-state), (ii) infra-path-or-hash (e.g. a NODE18 vscode-server bin hash, a hardcoded port/path), (iii) pane->role ROSTER (inline agent-pane maps). WITH a divergence/completeness check: a line matching the fact-about-the-world shape but in NO enumerated class => flagged for triage (a NEW state-shape cannot silently pass), never a fixed blind list (enumerate-not-universal, R40.54). The AC is worded so currency-checking (sprint/version) is only the INTERIM guard and does NOT entrench state-bearing boots as acceptable.

gateRef.assertion: a boot line that is a rotting FACT-ABOUT-THE-WORLD (version/commit/stash-ref/path/port/infra-hash/roster) in an active-state position => flagged/RED; a HOW-TO-FIND pointer => pass; an unclassified fact-shaped line => triage-flag, not silent-pass

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING multi: seed each subtle-state class in an active position -> flagged (a) stash@{0} transient-git-ref, (b) infra path/hash, (c) pane->role roster; AND a how-to-find pointer -> pass (positive control); AND a fact-shaped line in no enumerated class -> triage-flag not silent-pass

acceptanceCriteria.text: The ABSOLUTE no-active-state assertion ships WARN now, and flips to RED per-file as each agent's cure-migration lands (the R40.54 delta-vs-absolute lesson: do NOT RED-gate absolute-conformance before the migration that achieves it, or it false-fails the very files being cured). Per-boot conformance flag: state-bearing vs timeless+pointer; the currency check applies to state-bearing; a timeless+pointer boot passes by construction (nothing to rot). Publish the count of not-yet-cured boots, never falsely-drained.

gateRef.assertion: per-file: state-bearing => WARN until its cure lands then RED; timeless+pointer => pass; not-yet-cured count published, never false-drained

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a boot still state-bearing AFTER its cure-flag flips -> RED; a false-drained count -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Guard COVERAGE is fleet-wide: the discovered+evaluated set INCLUDES oosh* and other-team boots (a missing other-team boot => coverage RED). But REMEDIATION is NOT unilateral: rewriting another team's boot files is coordinated with THEIR PO. The guard may FLAG an other-team stale/state-bearing boot in its report, but an edit to an oosh-owned file requires oosh-PO coordination — coverage universal, remediation coordinated.

gateRef.assertion: oosh*/other-team boots ARE in the evaluated set (coverage); a missing other-team boot => RED. Remediation of oosh-owned files is process-gated on oosh-PO, not a unilateral edit.

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: drop an oosh boot from the evaluated set -> coverage RED

Until all three: UNVERIFIED.
model.contextAnchorCurrencyDebt: NAMED OBLIGATION (architect D5 + PO ruling 2026-08-20, DEFERRED — tracked not hoped): the state-removal cure moves state from boots INTO context.md anchors, which themselves go days-stale (rot moved one hop, not removed — an anchor is rot-EVIDENT, not rot-PROOF, since it MUST carry state). OBLIGATION: extend the currency invariant (AC-currency-invariant) to context.md anchors once boots are fully cured + L2 migration landed. INTERIM (now): verify-dont-trust anchor framing — a fresh-me treats the anchor as evidence to re-derive against git-HEAD, never as trusted truth (trainer propagates this framing). Sibling of extractionDebt; both live in the unit so they are tracked, not remembered.
